title: 第19章 不会失败的计划第20章 高傲表妹穆灵儿
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“真的是十方气海！
？”
韩正德和穆三娘闻言，纷纷动容。
虽然他们之前也隐隐猜测楚天铭开辟了十方气海，可是如今听到楚天铭亲口说出，还是感到万分震惊。
“哈哈，不错，看来真是老天爷开眼，给我韩正德送来一个好女婿啊！”
韩正德激动万分，宽大的手掌，用力的拍了拍楚天铭的肩膀，道：“天铭，以后你需要什么资源，只管跟岳父说，只要岳父能拿得出来，绝对不会吝啬。”
十方气海，意味着什么，韩正德自然心里清楚。
这样的绝世天才，若是能培养起来，韩家的未来，一定不可估量。
“多谢岳父。”
楚天铭笑了笑，道：“我刚刚得到一株千年雪莲，足以让我修炼一段时间了，暂时不需要什么。”
“好吧。”
韩正德目光一闪，然后沉声道：“天铭，那个韩枫为人险恶，你要多加小心一些。”
“岳父放心，我会小心应对的。”
韩正德点了点头，又似乎想起了什么，说道：“对了，过些日子，是天河城主的寿宴，老城主特意给我发了邀请函，我打算带你和清雪去一趟。”
岳父发话，楚天铭当然也不能回绝，点了点头道：“天铭明白。”
“好了，你这家伙，絮叨个没完没了，天铭现在应该很疲惫了，你还不快让他赶紧回去休息吧。”
穆三娘说道。
“哈哈，夫人提醒的是，是我疏忽了，清雪你扶着天铭去房间休息，记住好好照顾天铭。”
“女儿明白。”
韩清雪冲着楚天铭眨了眨眼睛，然后扶着楚天铭，向着后院走去。

看着楚天铭和韩清雪离开，穆三娘黛眉微微一皱：“奇怪。”
韩正德问道：“奇怪什么？”
穆三娘道：“我感觉清雪好像变了很多。”
韩正德一怔：“变了么？我怎么没看出来，难道她脸上的红斑更多了？不对，她戴着面纱，你也应该看不出来吧。”
穆三娘低声道：“不知道，或许是我的错觉，总觉得今日的清雪，跟以往不太一样。”
“你也是太关心她了。”
“废话，这是我唯一的女儿，我不关心谁关心？”
穆三娘没好气的白了韩正德一眼。
韩正德讪讪一笑，却是不敢反驳。
……
“虽然这次侥幸挡住了韩枫的三招，但是我跟韩枫的差距还是有点大，如果正常战斗的话，我绝对没有胜算，所以我得抓紧时间提升修为才行！”
回到房间的楚天铭，并没有因为今日的获胜太过高兴，反而认识到，自己与天河城的顶级天才还有些差距。
深吸一口气，他便将那株千年雪莲拿了出来，然后从上面摘下了一片灵叶，塞入了口中。
灵叶入口即化，无比浓郁的灵气，化作滚滚洪流，涌入他的经脉当中。
这千年雪莲是十分罕见的灵草，蕴含的灵气，自然也是非同小可。
仅仅是一片灵叶内蕴含的天地灵气，就比极品练气丹强大了数倍不止。
楚天铭连忙运转心法，开始吸收体内的天地灵气，丹田气海当中的真气，迅速攀升。
……
某个深夜。
content_en:
“It’s really a sea of qi from all directions!
? "
Han Zhengde and Mu Sanniang were moved when they heard this.
Although they had vaguely guessed that Chu Tianming had opened up the Shifang Qi Sea, they were still extremely shocked when they heard Chu Tianming say it himself.
"Haha, yes, it seems that God really opened his eyes and sent me, Han Zhengde, a good son-in-law!"
Han Zhengde was extremely excited. He patted Chu Tianming on the shoulder with his broad palm and said: "Tianming, if you need any resources in the future, just tell your father-in-law. As long as he can get it, I will never be stingy."
Han Zhengde naturally knew what the Ten Directions Sea of Qi meant.
If such a peerless genius can be cultivated, the future of the Han family will be immeasurable.
"Thank you, father-in-law."
Chu Tianming smiled and said: "I just got a thousand-year snow lotus, which is enough for me to practice for a while. I don't need anything for the time being."
"Okay."
Han Zhengde's eyes flashed, and then he said in a deep voice: "Tian Ming, that Han Feng is a sinister person, you should be more careful."
"Don't worry, father-in-law, I will handle it carefully."
Han Zhengde nodded, seemed to remember something, and said: "By the way, in a few days, it will be the birthday banquet of the Lord of Tianhe City. The old City Lord sent me an invitation specially. I plan to take you and Qingxue there."
When his father-in-law spoke, Chu Tianming certainly could not refuse. He nodded and said, "Tianming understands."
"Okay, you guy, you are nagging endlessly. Tian Ming should be very tired now. Why don't you tell him to go back and rest quickly."
Mu Sanniang said.
"Haha, Madam reminds me that I was negligent. Qingxue, help Tian Ming go to the room to rest. Remember to take good care of Tian Ming."
"My daughter understands."
Han Qingxue blinked at Chu Tianming, then supported Chu Tianming and walked towards the backyard.
Seeing Chu Tianming and Han Qingxue leaving, Mu Sanniang frowned slightly: "Strange."
Han Zhengde asked: "What's strange?"
Mu Sanniang said: "I feel like Qingxue has changed a lot."
Han Zhengde was startled: "Has it changed? Why didn't I see it? Are there more red spots on her face? No, she is wearing a veil, so you shouldn't be able to see it."
Mu Sanniang whispered: "I don't know, maybe it's my misunderstanding. I always feel that Qingxue today is different from before."
"You care about her too much."
"Nonsense, this is my only daughter, I don't care who cares?"
Mu Sanniang rolled her eyes at Han Zhengde angrily.
Han Zhengde smiled coquettishly, but did not dare to refute.
…
"Although I was lucky enough to block Han Feng's three moves this time, the gap between me and Han Feng is still a bit big. If we fight normally, I have absolutely no chance of winning, so I have to seize the time to improve my cultivation!"
When Chu Tianming returned to the room, he was not too happy about today's victory. Instead, he realized that there was still a gap between himself and Tianhe City's top geniuses.
Taking a deep breath, he took out the thousand-year-old snow lotus, plucked a spiritual leaf from it, and stuffed it into his mouth.
The spiritual leaves melted at the entrance, and the extremely rich spiritual energy turned into a rolling torrent and poured into his meridians.
This thousand-year-old snow lotus is a very rare spiritual grass, and the spiritual energy contained in it is naturally extraordinary.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth contained in just one spiritual leaf is several times more powerful than the best Qi training pill.
Chu Tianming quickly used his mental skills and began to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in his body. The true energy in the sea of ​​​​Qi in his Dantian increased rapidly.
…
Late one night.
